 News HONOR 11.11 Sale Opens With the HONOR Play 10 at PHP 1,111
 Emman Tortoza 
 · 
 November 9, 2026  ·  2 min read 
 f Facebook 
 🟢 WhatsApp 
 💬 Messenger 
 🔗 Copy link 
 Related topics 
 #Honor 
 #HONOR 11.11 Sale 
 HONOR Philippines is running its HONOR 11.11 Early Mega Christmas Sale from November 3 to 13, 2026, with a HONOR Play 10 at PHP 1,111 as the headline deal. That price is a Lazada exclusive, starts at 12:00 a.m. on November 11, and lasts while supplies hold. The wider campaign advertises discounts of up to PHP 30,000 on select devices, plus freebies and limited-time offers.
 What each platform offers
 Each marketplace carries a different set of offers, and the sale runs through HONOR Philippines’ official stores on all three.
 On Lazada , the PHP 1,111 HONOR Play 10 is the highlight deal. Shoppers can also take the HONOR Magic V6 on up to 24 months of 0% interest through participating bank credit cards. Shopee runs a “Watch the CEO’s New Jowa and Win an HONOR 600S” campaign, where the prize is the phone itself, plus the exclusive arrival of the HONOR Play 20A during the sale.
 TikTok Shop gets early access to the HONOR Pad X7b , with discounts of up to PHP 2,000, and freebies bundled with select devices including the HONOR 600S and the HONOR Pad X9b Max.
 Across the three platforms, the sale covers the Play 10 , Play 20A , Pad X7b, Pad X9b Max, 600S, and Magic V6, along with the HONOR Choice Earbuds Clip, HONOR Watch 6, and HONOR Choice Pencil.
 Payment options
 Across the HONOR 11.11 sale, eligible purchases may qualify for up to 24 months of 0% interest through major credit cards, and up to six months of 0% interest through participating PayLater services. Those options include SPayLater, LazPayLater, and TikTok PayLater.
 For more information, visit HONOR Philippines and follow the brand on Facebook , Instagram , and TikTok .
 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
 + How much is the HONOR Play 10 in the HONOR 11.11 sale? 
 PHP 1,111, on Lazada only, starting at 12:00 a.m. on November 11 while supplies last.
 + When does the sale run? 
 From November 3 to 13, 2026.
 + Where can I shop the sale? 
 HONOR Philippines’ official stores on Lazada, Shopee, and TikTok Shop.
 + What installment options are available? 
 Up to 24 months of 0% interest with participating bank credit cards, and up to six months of 0% interest through SPayLater, LazPayLater, or TikTok PayLater. Terms and conditions apply.
 + What offers are called out on each platform? 
 Lazada carries the PHP 1,111 Play 10 and the Magic V6 installment offer, Shopee carries the HONOR 600S giveaway and the Play 20A arrival, and TikTok Shop has early access to the Pad X7b.
